description: Add a company to the authenticated user's watchlist on HireJack (or remove it with action='unfollow'). Watched companies power `watchlist_intelligence`, daily job alerts, and the weekly digest. Idempotent — following an already-watched company is a no-op. Use when the user says 'watch this company', 'follow Stripe for me', or 'stop watching them'. Not for saving individual job postings — use `save_job` for that.

action.description: Default 'follow'. 'unfollow' removes the company from the watchlist.

domain.description: Company domain to watch, e.g. 'stripe.com'. Find domains via `search_companies`.

name: watch_company

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

changed.description: False when the call was a no-op (already in the requested state; see meta.note)

company.description: Company display name (present on an actual follow/unfollow)

following.description: Whether the company is on the watchlist after this call

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: Watch Company
